outcome: Incidence of low birth weight (< 2500 g)
cohort: The study included 113 women in Finland who gave birth after bariatric surgery between 2010 and 2022.
finding: Despite a higher incidence of gestational diabetes mellitus in the longer SCT group and lower mean newborn weight in the shorter SCT group, overall maternal and newborn outcomes were mostly similar between pregnancies with a surgery-to-conception time (SCT) less than 12 months and those with an SCT of 12 months or more.
mod_finding: The incidence rates of caesarean deliveries were similar between the groups (p = 1.00).
birth_weight: Mean newborn weight and incidence of low birth weight (< 2500g) were measured.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at delivery and incidence of small-for-gestational-age newborns were measured.
